StageMimi ni nani

A Creative Voice Driven By Culture

From the lush, rolling hills of Meru and the arid shrubs of Tharaka, my creative spirit was born.

Now, I lead creative at The Bar Africa, working with brands across the African market, from insurance and home appliances to logistics, events and culture, as well as leading the DMA Awards as Committee Chairperson.

The Bar Africa, Breast Cancer Awareness Month 2026

Signs To Look Out For

Ordinary road signs, rewritten to teach motorists the early signs of breast cancer and how to self-check. We reimagined 30 road signs and worked with 15 influencers to help save lives.

Roles Creative Direction, Writing, Website Development
More than 10 million impressions and counting
View the work ↗
NuVita

NoVita for NuVita

NuVita blends “new” and “vitality”, but in Swahili “vita” means fighting. When a TikTok influencer went to war against the brand, we designed special-edition NoVita packs, meaning “no fighting”, and sent them her way.

Roles Strategy, Creative Direction, Writing
Sales went from −3 to +20
View the work ↗
Digital Media Awards

DMA Committee Chair & DMAz Ignition

As DMA Committee Chairperson, I’ve helped the DMA grow across East Africa. In under three years, entries have tripled, DMAz launched to champion young creatives, and more than 30 free DMAx Masterclasses have tooled the industry and young people.

Roles Committee Chairperson, Strategy, Communication
Entries up threefold in under 3 years
View the work ↗
EABL Digitribe with USIU

Digibility

As Creative Director at EABL Digitribe, I led Digibility, training more than 30 students living with disabilities at USIU in digital skills and in facing the world, whatever the physical barriers.

Roles Strategy, Curriculum Development, Creative Direction, Program Management
30+ students trained
View the work ↗
THEATRE AFICIONADO

Too Early For Birds

Together with the team, I’ve helped make Too Early For Birds the largest theatre showcase in Kenya. Across 10 years, 9 editions and more than 40,000 attendees, we’ve told Kenyan stories on stage in the loudest, proudest ways.

Roles Marketing & Communications Lead, Company Director
4 awards at the Kenya Theatre Awards 2025
